sources.title: Introducing Inkling-Small - Thinking Machines Lab
sources.snippet: An open-weights model that matches Inkling at a quarter of the size: multimodal, Mixture-of-Experts, with controllable reasoning effort. Fine-tune it on Tinker.

sources.title: Use Inkling Small on Claude Code via AI Gateway - gentic.news
sources.snippet: What Changed — Inkling Small Lands on AI Gateway Thinking Machines released Inkling Small, now available through Vercel 's AI Gateway. The model delivers reasoning performance comparable to the full Inkling model at roughly one-quarter the size and compute cost. For Claude Code users who route through AI Gateway, this means a new, cheaper option for agentic coding, tool use, and visual tasks.

sources.title: Welcome Inkling by Thinking Machines - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Releasing a natively multimodal model (text, vision, and audio) open-weights is a huge step forward for the open-source AI ecosystem! Having variable and controllable thinking effort built into a MoE architecture makes Inkling a really attractive foundation for fine-tuning.
